transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, my eating habits have just gone completely off the rails lately. I usually track my food pretty carefully for work and fitness, but I just stopped caring about it. I think I skipped real meals for days at a time. I was basically just living on coffee and protein bars. I didn't even realize how bad it was until my clothes started hanging loose on me.
Have you been eating large amounts of food in a short period of time?
No, nothing like that. It's really been the exact opposite. I just haven't had much of an appetite at all, so I definitely haven't been eating large amounts of anything at once.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

No, not at all. Um, it's not about being afraid of gaining weight. If anything, I'm pretty frustrated that I'm losing it, since I usually work out and try to stay in shape. It's really just... I just haven't had any desire to eat right now. It has nothing to do with worrying about getting heavier.
Is there something on your mind that's been bothering you or causing you a lot of stress lately?

Not really, no. I mean... work is always a little busy since I'm in project management, but it's nothing out of the ordinary. There hasn't been any major crisis or anything specific weighing on my mind lately. I don't really know why my appetite just vanished, to be honest. There isn't any big stressor or problem I can point to.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... it really started after this one project sponsor questioned my judgment on a timeline. It was like... I don't know, like the bottom just dropped out. I ended up just sitting in my apartment for days, feeling completely hollow and ashamed. I was even crying over simple emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. It's just been this really heavy, sad feeling.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, sad feeling?

It's been about three months now. Ever since that issue with the project sponsor, it's just... dragged on. For the last three months, I've just felt completely hollow and ashamed. I really don't have any interest in doing much of anything anymore.
Have you lost interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah, definitely. I just... I haven't wanted to do much of anything. I usually like to go hiking, or edit photos... even just logging my meals, but I haven't had the desire for any of it. I also have this woodworking project sitting out in my garage that I haven't even touched in months. It's really strange for me, because doing those things usually keeps me grounded. But lately, I just don't care about them at all.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide lately?

Yeah, I have. Um... I started thinking that everyone at work would just be better off if I didn't wake up. And after that meeting, I actually said out loud that I should just walk into traffic and be done with it.
Have you had any difficulty sleeping lately?

Yeah, sleep has been really tough. Even when I actually try to get some rest, I just keep waking up at these weird hours. My mind just immediately goes right back to the deployment plan for work. By the time morning rolls around, I don't feel rested at all... I just feel completely wrecked.
Have you had any periods where you felt somewhat better over the past three months?
No, not really. It's just been a constant struggle. I haven't had any days where I felt like things were lifting or getting back to normal. It's just been this heavy feeling the whole time.
Have you felt any pleasure in doing things at all over the past three months?

No, not at all. I haven't really wanted to do anything. Normally, I like to hike, edit photos, log my meals... I even have a woodworking project sitting out in the garage that I haven't touched. It's strange because those are the things that usually keep me grounded, but lately, I just have zero interest in any of it.
Have you been feeling restless or slowed down lately?
I don't think so. I mean, I'm definitely exhausted from not sleeping, but... I haven't really noticed feeling physically restless or moving slower than usual. I'm mostly just really tired.
Have you had any days where you felt nearly normal over the past three months?
No, I haven't. Like I mentioned a minute ago, it's just been a constant struggle. I haven't had a single day where I felt like myself, or even close to normal.
Have you felt a lack of pleasure in activities that normally bring you joy?

Yeah, like I mentioned a couple of minutes ago... I really haven't. The things I normally enjoy, like hiking or that woodworking project, I just have zero interest in them right now. There's just no joy in any of it anymore.
Have you had any periods where your depressive feelings were worse than others over the past three months?

Not really. It's... I mean, it's just been consistently bad. I haven't really noticed it dipping lower at certain times because it's already just... a constant low. It all just kind of blurs together into one long, heavy stretch, to be honest.
Have you felt like you're moving more slowly than usual?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I feel heavy and tired all the time, but I wouldn't say I'm physically moving slower than normal. I'm just... existing, really. But my actual movements seem about the same.
